MARIJUANA SMOKING HITS RECORD HIGH IN US

Marijuana smoking among Americans has reached a record 17%, more than double the 7% reported in 2013, according to Gallup.

Meanwhile, cigarette smoking remains at a record low of 11%, while 9% of adults vape and 4% use nicotine pouches.
